goal: Validate Tor onion service IDs and private keys received from the control port and disk
Prevent command and argument injection into Tor control sockets on reconnect
agreement: Substantive support across reviewers with no open objections
Advocated strict character whitelisting over blacklisting (vasild)
Identified argument injection via spaces and suggested cached key checks (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents Tor control command injection from malicious or malformed keys
Closes a stability and security risk that could trigger unintended Tor shutdowns
